head: Orivo day planner app for iPhone turns timetable photos into events
dek: Orivo: Day Planner & Calendar is a $3.99 iPhone planner that shows what's happening now at the top and can turn a photo or screenshot of a class timetable or work roster into calendar events. It was #98 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: It has a timeline of your day hour by hour, a week list, a month calendar and an inbox for tasks you haven't scheduled yet. Tasks can have subtasks, alerts and notes, events can carry a location or a call link, and your Apple Calendar events show next to your tasks. There are ten Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and you can share a day, three days or a week as an image. The listing says it's one purchase with no subscription, in-app purchases, account or ads; it's made by Igon Neski Dela Cruz and came out on 13 October.
where: iPhone and iPad, App Store, $3.99 once
means: If you copy a school or shift timetable into your calendar by hand, Orivo says it can read it from a photo instead.
todo: Check that your iPhone runs iOS 17 or later (the listing's minimum) before you buy.
